verdict.rationale: Adyen Risk Management lets users configure custom risk rules and risk profiles that the Protect engine applies automatically to every transaction, deciding to block, allow or review without human input. That is the product's own autonomous background automation, but it is limited to fraud-decision rules rather than general user-defined automations. The Referrals API only lets developers automate list uploads, so it is a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose or recurring scheduled automations beyond transaction risk rules, agent-driven background workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The risk evaluation reaches a decision that results in an action to block, allow, or review the transaction.
